source.title: Silvina - The Taken Breath
source.name: Silvina
source.description: An Assassin who can prevent enemies from casting skills, and teleport to their side instantly at the start of battle.

skills.name: Shadow Slayer

description.raw: Silvina deals 300% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based) damage to an enemy and reduces their Energy by 200.
active: Silvina deals 300% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based) damage to an enemy and reduces their Energy by 200.

text: Unlocks at level 51: Increases damage to 320% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 111: Increases damage to 340% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 171: Increases damage to 360% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 231: Increases the Energy reduction to 300.

skills.description_lite: Silvina deals damage to the enemy with the most Energy, reducing their Energy.

skills.name: First Strike

description.raw: Silvina marks the closest enemy in a symmetrical position, flashes next to them, and launches an attack when a battle starts, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage.
active: Silvina marks the closest enemy in a symmetrical position, flashes next to them, and launches an attack when a battle starts, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage.

text: This attack stuns the enemy for 5s.

skills.description_lite: Silvina flashes next to the closest enemy in a symmetrical position and damages them when a battle starts.

skills.name: Blade Vortex

description.raw: Silvina's normal attack becomes Whirl Assault for the first 12s of battle. Each Whirl Assault deals 140% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage. Defeating the marked enemy prolongs the Whirl Assault duration by 6 + 2 (SP-based)s.
active: Silvina's normal attack becomes Whirl Assault for the first 12s of battle.
Defeating the marked enemy prolongs the Whirl Assault duration by 6 + 2 (SP-based)s.

skills.description_lite: Silvina's normal attacks are replaced by Whirl Attacks for a short time when a battle starts.

skills.name: Shield of Light

description.raw: Silvina gains a shield that can block up to 450% (ATK-based) damage after casting First Strike.
active: Silvina gains a shield that can block up to 450% (ATK-based) damage after casting First Strike.

text: When a marked enemy is defeated, Silvina frightens enemies within 2 tiles of the defeated enemy for 4s while Blade Vortex is in effect.

skills.description_lite: Gains a shield at the start of a battle.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Silvina also reduces the target's Vitality by 60 for 3s with each Whirl Assault.
active: Silvina also reduces the target's Vitality by 60 for 3s with each Whirl Assault.

skills.description_lite: Silvina reduces the target's Vitality with each Whirl Assault.
